long_biography.plain_text:
The Ciasulli family entered the automobile business before Tim Ciasulli took over management of its Union, New Jersey, dealership. He recast the store as Planet Honda and built a sales culture around employee continuity, customer loyalty and a less adversarial buying experience. The dealership grew from a relatively small outlet into one of Honda's leading American retailers.

Ciasulli paired that business career with offshore powerboat racing. Across more than three hundred races, he recorded over one hundred victories and set four world speed records, experience that reinforced a public identity built around performance and risk. He later moved into automotive-industry consulting through Nova Leadership Worldwide, applying the operating principles developed at Planet Honda to leadership and business advice.
